items.one_liner: better-npm-audit through 3.11.0 allows command injection via unescaped registry options passed to a shell execution function.
items.summary: The better-npm-audit package through version 3.11.0 and the 4.0.0-rc.2 prerelease contain a high-severity command injection vulnerability. The tool constructs its npm audit command by directly interpolating the user-supplied --registry option into a string without validation or quoting, then passes it to child_process.exec(), which spawns a shell. An attacker who supplies a registry string containing shell metacharacters such as semicolons or pipes can execute arbitrary operating system commands with the privileges of the running process.
items.bottom_line: Passing malicious registry parameters to vulnerable versions of better-npm-audit will execute arbitrary OS commands with process privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-62243 (HIGH 8.7): Netty (io.netty:netty-handler) versions from 4.2.0.Final through 4.2.16.Final and versions through 4.1.136.Fi…
items.one_liner: Netty client OpenSSL path disables TLS hostname verification under certain Java configurations, enabling MITM attacks.
items.summary: Netty handler versions 4.2.0.Final through 4.2.16.Final and versions up to 4.1.136.Final disable TLS hostname verification on the SslProvider.OPENSSL client path under specific configurations. This occurs when a plain X509TrustManager is utilized and Unsafe-based trust-manager wrapping is unavailable, notably on Java 25 and newer. Consequently, the OpenSSL client fails to validate server hostnames, allowing man-in-the-middle attackers to present certificates issued for different domains and have them accepted without error. The issue is fixed in versions 4.2.17.Final and 4.1.137.Final.
items.bottom_line: Applications running Netty on Java 25+ with specific trust managers are vulnerable to MITM certificate spoofing due to disabled hostname verification.

items.summary: NLTK versions prior to 3.10.2 contain a symlink-based sandbox bypass vulnerability in FramenetCorpusReader. Attackers can place symbolic links with names lacking path separators inside the corpus subdirectory to successfully bypass path validation checks. When accessed via methods such as frame_by_name(), _lu_file(), or doc(), these symlinks resolve to arbitrary XML files outside the intended corpus root. This flaw allows unauthorized reading of sensitive files from the host system.
items.bottom_line: Attackers can exploit symlink flaws in NLTK's FramenetCorpusReader to read arbitrary files outside the corpus root directory.

claims.text:
基于 ProxyPin 与 Model Context Protocol（MCP）的自动化抓包、API 分析、Mock 场景和数据归档工作台。
本项目面向开发、测试和个人数据迁移场景，将传统抓包工具里的“查看单条请求”扩展为可以长期复用的工作流：按任务归档请求、整理 API 资产、组合 Mock 规则，并让本地 AI 客户端通过 MCP 分析当前抓包会话。
本项目是非官方衍生项目，与 ProxyPin 及下列上游作者不存在官方隶属、授权代理或背书关系。请只分析自己拥有或明确获授权的设备、账号、应用和流量。
以下截图使用空白状态或匿名示例数据，不包含真实 Token、Cookie、设备标识、用户资料或业务域名。
本机抓包会将 macOS 流量从普通设备抓包中单独归拢，并支持按来源应用筛选。
- 自动化工作台：统一管理抓包项目、API 资产、数据导出和 Mock 场景。
- 抓包项目归档：按任务隔离请求并持续写入独立归档，清空实时列表也不会丢失项目记录。
- 采集方案：保存域名范围和人工操作步骤，下次可以按同一流程重新采集。
- API 资产整理：按方法、路径和响应结构聚合请求，减少重复翻找。
- 数据导出：从归档中提取结构化记录，导出经过脱敏的 JSON 或 CSV。
- Mock 场景合集：多条请求重写规则归入同一合集，通过一个开关整体启停。
- 双列详情视图：宽屏同时查看 Request 与 Response；窄屏自动回退为标签页。
- 本机应用归类：将 macOS 本机流量单独归拢，按已捕获应用筛选请求，同时保留手机与远端设备抓包视图。
- MCP 自动化：本地 AI 客户端可以搜索请求、读取详情、对比接口和管理授权范围内的 Mock。
代码、配置和截图中的产品名称、业务域名与场景均使用匿名或公开示例，例如“示例育儿应用”“示例订阅应用”和 example.com。
- Flutter（建议使用项目配置对应的 FVM 版本）
- macOS、Windows、Linux、Android 或 iOS 开发环境
- macOS 桌面调试需要 Xcode 与 CocoaPods
fvm flutter pub get
fvm flutter run -d macos
如果没有安装 FVM，也可以使用兼容版本的 flutter 命令。
- 让手机和运行本项目的电脑连接同一局域网。
- 在手机 Wi-Fi 中把 HTTP 代理指向电脑的局域网 IP 和应用显示的 HTTP 端口。
- 先验证普通 HTTP 转发，再安装由当前设备本地生成的 CA。
- iPhone 安装描述文件后，还需要在“证书信任设置”中开启完全信任。
- HTTPS 解密尽量限定到正在测试的域名。
- 完成后关闭手机代理、移除不再使用的 CA，并清理包含凭据的导出文件。
详细流程见仓库内置的 ProxyPin 抓包工作流 Skill。
默认情况下，MCP 服务只监听本机回环地址，手机连接的是 HTTP 代理端口，AI 客户端连接的是 MCP 端口，两者不要混用。
MCP 健康检查：http://127.0.0.1:9101/health
MCP JSON-RPC：http://127.0.0.1:9101/message
使用仓库内的脱敏客户端：
python3 skills/proxypin-capture-workflow/scripts/proxypin_mcp.py health
python3 skills/proxypin-capture-workflow/scripts/proxypin_mcp.py tools
python3 skills/proxypin-capture-workflow/scripts/proxypin_mcp.py \
  call search_requests '{"urlKeyword":"example.com","limit":20}'
辅助脚本默认遮盖常见 Token、Authorization、Cookie 和密码字段。只有确实需要在本机完成转换时才使用 --raw，不要把原始输出提交到仓库或粘贴到公开 Issue。
本项目附带一套可复用的 ProxyPin 工作流：
skills/proxypin-capture-workflow/
├── SKILL.md
├── agents/openai.yaml
├── references/
│   ├── capture-setup.md
│   ├── export-and-mock.md
│   └── mcp-analysis.md
└── scripts/proxypin_mcp.py
可以将整个目录复制到 Codex Skills 目录：
cp -R skills/proxypin-capture-workflow ~/.codex/skills/
Skill 包含手机代理诊断、iOS/Android CA 配置、MCP 请求分析、个人数据导出校验和 Mock 合集管理边界。
- 仅处理自己拥有或明确获授权的流量。
- 不要提交 HAR、抓包历史、运行日志、导出数据、Cookie、Authorization、查询 Token、设备标识或家庭成员资料。
- 不要把 MCP 服务暴露到局域网或公网。
- 不提供证书固定绕过、越狱、Root、Frida 注入或第三方付费权益绕过方案。
- Mock 只能用于自己的应用或明确授权的测试环境。
- 安装 CA 等同于授予 HTTPS 解密能力；只信任当前设备本地生成且指纹可核对的 CA。
本分支不再随安装包分发共享 CA 私钥。新安装会在首次启动时于本机应用数据目录生成唯一 CA，私钥在 macOS/Linux 上限制为仅当前用户可读写。由旧版本升级的用户应在证书管理中重新生成一次 CA，并重新安装、核对和信任新证书。更多说明见 SECURITY.md。
fvm flutter analyze lib/network/util/crts.dart lib/features/workbench
fvm flutter test test/capture_plan_test.dart \
  test/har_archive_recovery_test.dart \
  test/network_panel_split_layout_test.dart \
  test/request_rewrite_diagnostics_test.dart \
  test/workbench_services_test.dart
fvm flutter build macos --debug
git diff --check
仓库还保留了部分上游的手工联调脚本，它们依赖本机证书样本、临时文件或本地 HTTP 服务，不属于可离线重复执行的自动化测试；公开发布前以以上定向测试和实际构建为准。
界面改动至少应验证：宽屏与窄屏布局、Request/Response 正文、SSE/WebSocket、Cookies、Mock 诊断和跨断点窗口缩放。
本公开仓库从经过脱敏的代码快照开始记录历史，并基于以下项目继续开发：
- wanghongenpin/proxypin：原始 ProxyPin 项目。
- SuxyEE/proxypin-mcp：早期 MCP 集成实现。
- ouy160/proxypin-mcp-model：本仓库直接采用的代码基线。
感谢所有上游作者和贡献者。上游链接、许可证与详细署名见 NOTICE；需要追溯原始实现时，请以对应上游仓库的公开历史为准。
本项目继续采用 Apache License 2.0。原项目的版权、许可证和署名信息予以保留；新增代码及修改部分的版权归相应贡献者所有。
claims.support_span:
基于 ProxyPin 与 Model Context Protocol（MCP）的自动化抓包、API 分析、Mock 场景和数据归档工作台。
本项目面向开发、测试和个人数据迁移场景，将传统抓包工具里的“查看单条请求”扩展为可以长期复用的工作流：按任务归档请求、整理 API 资产、组合 Mock 规则，并让本地 AI 客户端通过 MCP 分析当前抓包会话。
本项目是非官方衍生项目，与 ProxyPin 及下列上游作者不存在官方隶属、授权代理或背书关系。请只分析自己拥有或明确获授权的设备、账号、应用和流量。
以下截图使用空白状态或匿名示例数据，不包含真实 Token、Cookie、设备标识、用户资料或业务域名。
本机抓包会将 macOS 流量从普通设备抓包中单独归拢，并支持按来源应用筛选。
- 自动化工作台：统一管理抓包项目、API 资产、数据导出和 Mock 场景。
- 抓包项目归档：按任务隔离请求并持续写入独立归档，清空实时列表也不会丢失项目记录。
- 采集方案：保存域名范围和人工操作步骤，下次可以按同一流程重新采集。
- API 资产整理：按方法、路径和响应结构聚合请求，减少重复翻找。
- 数据导出：从归档中提取结构化记录，导出经过脱敏的 JSON 或 CSV。
- Mock 场景合集：多条请求重写规则归入同一合集，通过一个开关整体启停。
- 双列详情视图：宽屏同时查看 Request 与 Response；窄屏自动回退为标签页。
- 本机应用归类：将 macOS 本机流量单独归拢，按已捕获应用筛选请求，同时保留手机与远端设备抓包视图。
- MCP 自动化：本地 AI 客户端可以搜索请求、读取详情、对比接口和管理授权范围内的 Mock。
代码、配置和截图中的产品名称、业务域名与场景均使用匿名或公开示例，例如“示例育儿应用”“示例订阅应用”和 example.com。
- Flutter（建议使用项目配置对应的 FVM 版本）
- macOS、Windows、Linux、Android 或 iOS 开发环境
- macOS 桌面调试需要 Xcode 与 CocoaPods
fvm flutter pub get
fvm flutter run -d macos
如果没有安装 FVM，也可以使用兼容版本的 flutter 命令。
- 让手机和运行本项目的电脑连接同一局域网。
- 在手机 Wi-Fi 中把 HTTP 代理指向电脑的局域网 IP 和应用显示的 HTTP 端口。
- 先验证普通 HTTP 转发，再安装由当前设备本地生成的 CA。
- iPhone 安装描述文件后，还需要在“证书信任设置”中开启完全信任。
- HTTPS 解密尽量限定到正在测试的域名。
- 完成后关闭手机代理、移除不再使用的 CA，并清理包含凭据的导出文件。
详细流程见仓库内置的 ProxyPin 抓包工作流 Skill。
默认情况下，MCP 服务只监听本机回环地址，手机连接的是 HTTP 代理端口，AI 客户端连接的是 MCP 端口，两者不要混用。
MCP 健康检查：http://127.0.0.1:9101/health
MCP JSON-RPC：http://127.0.0.1:9101/message
使用仓库内的脱敏客户端：
python3 skills/proxypin-capture-workflow/scripts/proxypin_mcp.py health
python3 skills/proxypin-capture-workflow/scripts/proxypin_mcp.py tools
python3 skills/proxypin-capture-workflow/scripts/proxypin_mcp.py \
  call search_requests '{"urlKeyword":"example.com","limit":20}'
辅助脚本默认遮盖常见 Token、Authorization、Cookie 和密码字段。只有确实需要在本机完成转换时才使用 --raw，不要把原始输出提交到仓库或粘贴到公开 Issue。
本项目附带一套可复用的 ProxyPin 工作流：
skills/proxypin-capture-workflow/
├── SKILL.md
├── agents/openai.yaml
├── references/
│   ├── capture-setup.md
│   ├── export-and-mock.md
│   └── mcp-analysis.md
└── scripts/proxypin_mcp.py
可以将整个目录复制到 Codex Skills 目录：
cp -R skills/proxypin-capture-workflow ~/.codex/skills/
Skill 包含手机代理诊断、iOS/Android CA 配置、MCP 请求分析、个人数据导出校验和 Mock 合集管理边界。
- 仅处理自己拥有或明确获授权的流量。
- 不要提交 HAR、抓包历史、运行日志、导出数据、Cookie、Authorization、查询 Token、设备标识或家庭成员资料。
- 不要把 MCP 服务暴露到局域网或公网。
- 不提供证书固定绕过、越狱、Root、Frida 注入或第三方付费权益绕过方案。
- Mock 只能用于自己的应用或明确授权的测试环境。
- 安装 CA 等同于授予 HTTPS 解密能力；只信任当前设备本地生成且指纹可核对的 CA。
本分支不再随安装包分发共享 CA 私钥。新安装会在首次启动时于本机应用数据目录生成唯一 CA，私钥在 macOS/Linux 上限制为仅当前用户可读写。由旧版本升级的用户应在证书管理中重新生成一次 CA，并重新安装、核对和信任新证书。更多说明见 SECURITY.md。
fvm flutter analyze lib/network/util/crts.dart lib/features/workbench
fvm flutter test test/capture_plan_test.dart \
  test/har_archive_recovery_test.dart \
  test/network_panel_split_layout_test.dart \
  test/request_rewrite_diagnostics_test.dart \
  test/workbench_services_test.dart
fvm flutter build macos --debug
git diff --check
仓库还保留了部分上游的手工联调脚本，它们依赖本机证书样本、临时文件或本地 HTTP 服务，不属于可离线重复执行的自动化测试；公开发布前以以上定向测试和实际构建为准。
界面改动至少应验证：宽屏与窄屏布局、Request/Response 正文、SSE/WebSocket、Cookies、Mock 诊断和跨断点窗口缩放。
本公开仓库从经过脱敏的代码快照开始记录历史，并基于以下项目继续开发：
- wanghongenpin/proxypin：原始 ProxyPin 项目。
- SuxyEE/proxypin-mcp：早期 MCP 集成实现。
- ouy160/proxypin-mcp-model：本仓库直接采用的代码基线。
感谢所有上游作者和贡献者。上游链接、许可证与详细署名见 NOTICE；需要追溯原始实现时，请以对应上游仓库的公开历史为准。

items.title: BanglaVeilGuard: Cross-Script Safety Benchmarking and Lightweight Guardrails for Bangla Large Language Models
items.one_liner: This is a significant development for securing LLM deployments in the linguistically complex Indian and Bengali markets.
items.summary: BanglaVeilGuard is a new safety benchmark and prompt guard designed to secure Bangla LLMs against unsafe inputs across multiple scripts and dialects. The system addresses the challenge of Bangla users frequently mixing scripts (Romanized, Banglish) and regional registers, which standard English-centric benchmarks miss. By using multi-view normalization and a prompt-risk classifier, the guard screens prompts without requiring changes to the underlying model's weights. Testing showed a dramatic reduction in attack success rates for models like Claude Opus 4.8 and BanglaLLama, though it does increase over-refusal on benign dialectal prompts.
items.bottom_line: Effective safety for Bangla LLMs requires handling cross-script and code-mixed inputs rather than relying on standard-script benchmarks.

claims.text: The benchmark includes 2,366 quality-filtered prompts covering six language forms.
claims.support_span: The benchmark contains 2,366 quality-filtered prompts and a held-out 354-prompt evaluation split spanning unsafe, safe, and safe-sensitive requests.

claims.text: The prompt guard reduced attack success rates for Claude Opus 4.8 to 6.3%.
claims.support_span: Across target-model families, guarded runs reduce attack success under deterministic response scoring from 93.8--100.0% to 6.3% for Claude Opus 4.8, BanglaLLama, and TituLLM

claims.text: The system uses multi-view normalization to screen prompts without altering model weights.
claims.support_span: BanglaVeilGuard uses non-destructive multi-view normalization with a prompt-risk classifier and thresholded pre-generation gate, allowing it to screen prompts for heterogeneous target models without changing their weights.

items.title: AgentFlow: A Flow-Centric Policy Language and Framework for Securing LLM Agent Systems
items.one_liner: This framework provides a robust way to implement data-flow guardrails in agentic systems, preventing multi-step exploitation.
items.summary: AgentFlow is a new policy language and runtime framework designed to secure LLM agents by monitoring the flow of sensitive data across multiple steps. Unlike traditional systems that check single actions, AgentFlow uses a reference monitor to enforce constraints on where data can travel, including tool invocations and delegation boundaries. Evaluation on benchmarks like AgentDojo showed that the framework could reduce confirmed compromises from 33% to 0% while actually improving overall utility. The system includes an SMT-based verifier to check safety properties in under half a second.
items.bottom_line: Securing LLM agents requires monitoring data flows across sequences of actions rather than just validating individual steps in isolation.

claims.text: AgentFlow reduced confirmed compromise from 33.0% to 0.0% on the AgentDojo benchmark.
claims.support_span: On 949 AgentDojo injected cases across four suites, AgentFlow reduces confirmed compromise from 33.0% to 0.0% while improving aggregate utility from 46.7% to 63.3%.

claims.text: The framework uses a runtime reference monitor to mediate agent actions.
claims.support_span: A runtime reference monitor mediates agent actions, and a bounded SMT-based verifier checks safety properties for a structured policy fragment.

claims.text: Safety properties can be verified in less than 0.5 seconds.
claims.support_span: In our prototype, seven safety properties verify in under 0.5 seconds each, and the verifier catches all seeded unsafe policy variants in our study.

items.title: CyberFactory: Scaling Cyber Security Capabilities with Instances from the Wild
items.one_liner: CyberFactory converts public CVEs into executable task instances to train open-source security agents that outperform base models.
items.summary: While closed-source LLMs advance in cybersecurity capabilities, open-source solutions often lack reproducible training and scalable agentic data. Researchers introduced CyberFactory, a unified open-source framework connecting data construction, trajectory synthesis, and model training for tasks like proof-of-concept generation, vulnerability patching, and CyberQA. CyberFactory converts public CVE artifacts into executable task instances and uses a reusable vulnerability-analysis skill to guide teacher models through execution feedback. Using these trajectories, the team trained a security model that reaches 52.4% Pass@1 on CyberGym under a one-hour budget, outperforming its Qwen 3.5 base model by 22.8 points.
key_facts: Improvement: +22.8 points over Qwen 3.5 base model

items.title: 24 npm Packages Abuse unpkg Mirrors to Host Fake Cloudflare CAPTCHA Pages
items.one_liner: This highlights a clever supply-chain abuse where the npm registry itself is used as a CDN for phishing pages.
items.summary: Researchers have discovered a campaign where 24 npm packages are being used as free hosting infrastructure for phishing pages by abusing unpkg mirrors. The packages contain a single HTML page that, when rendered via unpkg.com, displays a fake Cloudflare CAPTCHA designed to redirect users to ClickFix phishing sites. The threat actors have also utilized KeyVal, a public key-value store, as a dead drop resolver to dynamically update redirection URLs and evade domain blocklists. This technique allows malicious content to persist on trusted CDN infrastructure even after the original packages are removed from the npm registry.
items.bottom_line: Attackers are turning legitimate developer tools and npm mirrors into persistent, trusted hosting for phishing infrastructure that is difficult to take down.
